notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 5 life this turn.
description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
